parameters.query:
WITH active AS (
  SELECT id, name, current_phase, project_type, location_city, created_at, updated_at
  FROM projects
  WHERE current_phase NOT IN ('completed','archived')
)
SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.flag_score DESC, t.days_in_phase DESC) AS rows
FROM (
  SELECT
    a.id, a.name, a.current_phase, a.project_type, a.location_city,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - a.updated_at))/86400 AS days_in_phase,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM approvals WHERE project_id = a.id AND status = 'pending') AS pending_approvals,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM site_reports WHERE project_id = a.id AND reported_at > now() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS reports_7d,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM site_reports WHERE project_id = a.id AND status = 'flagged' AND reported_at > now() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS reports_flagged_7d,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE project_id = a.id AND created_at > now() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS invoices_7d,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE project_id = a.id AND status = 'pending_review') AS invoices_pending,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM permit_applications WHERE project_id = a.id AND status NOT IN ('approved','rejected','withdrawn','expired')) AS permits_active,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM permit_applications WHERE project_id = a.id AND status = 'requires_subsanation') AS permits_subsanation,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM regulatory_tasks WHERE project_id = a.id AND status = 'requires_review') AS reg_tasks_review,
    (SELECT total_estimated FROM cost_estimates WHERE project_id = a.id ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1) AS estimated,
    COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM certifications WHERE project_id = a.id AND status != 'cancelled'), 0) AS certified,
    COALESCE((SELECT sum(total_amount) FROM invoices WHERE project_id = a.id), 0) AS billed,
    (SELECT title FROM design_options WHERE project_id = a.id AND is_selected = true LIMIT 1) AS selected_design,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM pathology_findings WHERE project_id = a.id AND status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed')) AS pathologies_open,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM pathology_findings WHERE project_id = a.id AND severity IN ('high','critical') AND status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed')) AS pathologies_critical,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM aftercare_incidents WHERE project_id = a.id AND status NOT IN ('resolved','closed','disputed')) AS aftercare_open,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM aftercare_incidents WHERE project_id = a.id AND severity = 'urgent' AND status NOT IN ('resolved','closed','disputed')) AS aftercare_urgent,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM anomalies_detected WHERE project_id = a.id AND status = 'new') AS anomalies_new,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM anomalies_detected WHERE project_id = a.id AND severity IN ('high','critical') AND status = 'new') AS anomalies_critical,
    -- flag_score: prioriza visualmente proyectos que necesitan atencion
    (CASE WHEN a.current_phase IN ('intake') AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - a.updated_at))/86400 > 3 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - a.updated_at))/86400 > 14 THEN 4 ELSE 0 END +
     COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM site_reports WHERE project_id = a.id AND status = 'flagged' AND reported_at > now() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 0) * 3 +
     COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM permit_applications WHERE project_id = a.id AND status = 'requires_subsanation'), 0) * 2 +
     COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM approvals WHERE project_id = a.id AND status = 'pending'), 0) +
     COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM pathology_findings WHERE project_id = a.id AND severity IN ('high','critical') AND status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed')), 0) * 4 +
     COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM aftercare_incidents WHERE project_id = a.id AND severity = 'urgent' AND status NOT IN ('resolved','closed','disputed')), 0) * 5 +
     COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM anomalies_detected WHERE project_id = a.id AND severity IN ('high','critical') AND status = 'new'), 0) * 3) AS flag_score
  FROM active a
) t;
SELECT value FROM system_config WHERE key = 'architect_email'
